literal: Having envied, even those who prospered are not; those who do not have that, even those who departed from prosperity are not.
translation: No one has ever achieved greatness through envy. Likewise, no one free from envy has ever fallen from prosperity.
modern: பொறாமை கொண்டு வாழ்வில் உயர்ந்தவர்களும் இல்லை; பொறாமை இல்லாதவர்கள் செல்வத்திலிருந்து நீங்கித் தாழ்ந்தவர்களும் இல்லை.
explanation: The couplet states a clear rule about the consequences of envy. It says that those who harbor envy never achieve true greatness or prosperity. Conversely, those who are completely free from that flaw never lose their prosperity. The word 'அகன்றார்' means those who have expanded or grown great, while 'தீர்ந்தார்' means those who have fallen away or separated from their wealth.
